title: Oil and gas company drills beside the mesa drill site
place_text: northern border of Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: all of a sudden an oil and gas company appears, ramrods permits through

plain: Just as drilling was going on at a mesa on Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events, an oil and gas company suddenly showed up on the ranch's northern border and, in the owner's words, "ramrods permits through" to drill next door. The ranch's owner tells this himself, giving no date. If true, it would suggest someone else wanted to get at whatever lies under that spot.
